user.title: Connect Codex usage
user.description: Read your Codex allowance and reset time every five minutes. Enable device code sign-in in [ChatGPT Security Settings](https://chatgpt.com/#settings/Security), then continue to obtain a sign-in code.

login.title: Sign in to ChatGPT
login.description: Open [ChatGPT device sign-in](https://auth.openai.com/codex/device) and enter **{code}**. Once sign-in is complete, select Submit here. The code expires after 15 minutes. Home Assistant uses its own login; the desktop app is not needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Codex usage
reauth_confirm.description: ChatGPT rejected this session. Continue to sign in again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Codex. Try again shortly.
error.authorization_pending: Complete ChatGPT sign-in, then select Submit.

abort.authentication_failed: ChatGPT could not authorize this login. Start setup again.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original ChatGPT account.
